model: Ratings v5 (v4 ratings; impact with power-play-creating penalty units, separate drawn / taken shrinkage and PP finishing)

impact.baseline: position average (F / D): every per-60 rate centred on its TOI-weighted mean among rated roster skaters of the group

prod.definition: Game Score per game (Luszczyszyn 2016: 0.75 G + 0.7 A1 + 0.55 A2 + 0.075 SOG + 0.05 BLK + 0.15 PD - 0.15 PT + 0.01 FOW - 0.01 FOL + 0.05 CF - 0.05 CA + 0.15 GF - 0.15 GA, CF / CA / GF / GA on-ice 5v5), recency-weighted like the ratings, shrunk with pseudo_games of the position mean; prod = games x (gs_pg - mean)

units.impact: goals per 82 games above an average player at his position (F / D): off_impact + def_impact (EV, PP / PK, finishing and penalties)
units.off_impact: goals per 82 games: EV offence + PP offence + EV and PP finishing + penalties drawn, each x his expected minutes
units.def_impact: goals per 82 games: EV defence + PK defence - penalties taken, each x his expected minutes
units.sd: posterior SD of impact (EV and PP / PK rating uncertainty; TOI and FIN taken as known)
units.ev_off: EV xGF/60 vs an average skater (higher is better)
units.ev_def: EV xGA/60 prevented vs an average skater (higher is better)
units.pp_off: PP xGF/60 vs an average PP skater (higher is better)
units.pk_def: PK xGA/60 prevented vs an average PK skater (higher is better)
units.fin: EV goals above xG per 60 from his own shots, shrunk (higher is better)
units.off: EV xGF/60 vs average (= ev_off, the v2 name)
units.def: EV xGA/60 prevented vs average (= ev_def, the v2 name)
units.toi: EV minutes, window seasons + this season
units.pen_impact: goals per 82 games from penalties drawn minus taken vs his position (included in off / def_impact)
units.pd60: penalties drawn per 60 all-situation minutes, in power-play-creating minor equivalents (every penalty, scaled by the share of his position's penalties that create a power play; shrunk)
units.pt60: penalties taken per 60 all-situation minutes, in power-play-creating minor equivalents (every penalty, scaled by the share of his position's penalties that create a power play; shrunk)
units.spm_off: box-score prior of ev_off: what his individual stats alone predict (EV xGF/60, higher is better)
units.spm_def: box-score prior of ev_def (EV xGA/60 prevented, higher is better)
units.fin_pp: PP goals above xG per 60 PP minutes from his own shots, shrunk (higher is better; in off_impact x his PP minutes)
units.prod: production score, descriptive (not a rating): recency-weighted NHL Game Score (Luszczyszyn 2016) per game, shrunk, as Game Score per 82 games above an average player at his position (F / D)
units.gs_pg: recency-weighted Game Score per game, shrunk to his position's mean (the level behind prod)
